mapper.select: select from user_address where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
select from user_address where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into user_address ( user_id, name, phone, tag_name, province_code, city_code, district_code, address, full_address, is_default, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{tagName}, #{provinceCode}, #{cityCode}, #{districtCode}, #{address}, #{fullAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: update user_address set name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, tag_name = #{tagName}, province_code = #{provinceCode}, city_code = #{cityCode}, district_code = #{districtCode}, address = #{address}, full_address = #{fullAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, update_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
update user_address set is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
